Q1.rationale: Segment 26 requires return or certified destruction of all copies upon completion of the Business Purpose or written request, which is a close analogue of return on termination.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: The NDA contains no prohibition on reverse engineering, disassembling or decompiling objects embodying Confidential Information.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 32 states nothing in the Agreement grants any rights by licence or otherwise in the Information except as provided herein.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segments 8 and 9 protect only information marked or identified as confidential, so the disclosing party must identify it, though the rule is not stated for all information.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: Exhibit A segments 69 and 70 cover business support services, commercial and business opportunities, and prices and monetary matters, which goes beyond technical information.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: Segment 26 requires all copies to be returned or certified destroyed, with no right to retain any Information after return or destruction.
Q6.label: Contradiction

Q7.rationale: Segment 40 prohibits any public announcement or disclosure relating to the Agreement without prior written consent, which is close to a restriction on disclosing that the Agreement exists; segment 70 covers discussions on monetary matters.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Segment 15 excludes information independently developed by the recipient without use of the other party's Information.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 7 keeps the protection obligations running for five years from receipt of the information, which operates beyond the end of the business relationship.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Segment 9 covers oral information identified as confidential at disclosure and later reduced to writing.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation provision covering the other party's representatives.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 6 permits sharing with a parent corporation, subsidiaries and their employees, but does not mention consultants, agents or professional advisors.
Q12.label: NotMentioned

Q13.rationale: The NDA does not expressly permit making copies; segment 26 only refers to returning all copies.
Q13.label: NotMentioned

Q14.rationale: Segments 18 and 24 require the disclosing party to give written notice before disclosure required by a governmental or legal requirement.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 14 excludes information rightfully received from a third party, which implies the recipient may acquire such information.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 6 permits use and provision of information to the employees of the parent and subsidiaries for the Business Purpose, but does not expressly name the Receiving Party's own employees.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 6 limits use of the information to use only in connection with the Business Purpose.
Q17.label: Entailment
